facts.function: choker grapples and slack-pulling carriages for yarding/handling logs

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8428 other lifting/handling machinery; subheading 8428.90.03 provides eo nomine for woodland log handling equipment
GRI 6: 8428.90.03.10 woodland log handling equipment (other than skidders)

rejected_alternatives.reason: parts of 8428 machinery; H81340 concerned a hanger for a log loader, whereas these are logging handling equipment themselves

missing_facts: whether carriages are self-propelled or are mere parts of a yarder
classification.rationale: Logging-industry grapples and carriages are lifting/handling equipment for logs, covered by the 8428.90.03.10 woodland log handling equipment line. H81340 shows grapple-related articles are in 8428 family; if treated as parts, 8431.39.00.80 would apply.
